title: Pajamas to Paradise
tagline: Wake up aboard a dying starship and find your way to paradise.
teaser: The 1979 Berkeley text adventure with its own words intact and every room drawn in 3D: escape a dying starship in your pajamas, fly the last fighter through a dogfight, and explore a tropical island of charms, caves and old riddles.

manPage.synopsis: battlestar — type what you want to do: explore, take, use, escape.
manPage.description: David Riggle wrote the original in 1979 to try out the C language, with help from Chris Guthrie, Peter Da Silva, Kevin Brown and Edward Wang.

howToPlay: Type short commands: look, take, wear, ahead, left, up.
Escape the ship, land on the island and explore it.
The hint panel (`) suggests what to try next.
